arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import re
# Greedy * matches as much as possible
pattern = r'(hello)( )*'
text = 'hello       world'
m = re.search(pattern, text)
print('Greedy:', repr(m.group(0)))

# Non-greedy *? matches as little as possible  
pattern2 = r'(hello)(.*?)'
m2 = re.search(pattern2, text)
print('Non-greedy:', repr(m2.group(0)))
"
